microprocessor.name: Hybrid Full
microprocessor.description: Series hybrid. Genset on the engine. Starter clutch engine↔motor. Lua control. Do not pipe the generator through the starter clutch.

node.label: Ignition
node.description: Seat key

node.label: Seat
node.description: Seat data — W/S is number ch 2 (W throttle, S brake)

node.label: Reverse
node.description: Holds 1st + motor reverse

node.label: EV mode
node.description: Engine only if battery low or charge hold

node.label: Charge hold
node.description: Motors off — diesel + regen only

node.label: Engine RPS
node.description: Controller RPS (>idle = running)

node.label: Battery
node.description: Charge 0..1

node.label: Wheel RPS
node.description: Wheel RPS (shift)

node.label: Physics
node.description: Physics sensor — number ch 13 is abs speed m/s

node.label: Engine
node.description: Controller on/off

node.label: Engine Throttle
node.description: Load 0..1 (0 idle)

node.label: Starter Clutch
node.description: Engine↔motor — crank, then lock while driving if RPS ≥ idle (5)

node.label: Drive Clutch
node.description: Motor→wheels — fades in on throttle/reverse, never ignition alone

node.label: Engine Gen
node.description: Engine→generator — locked once RPS ≥ idle, off while starting

node.label: Regen Clutch
node.description: Trans gen — brake at speed if battery not full

node.label: Wheel Brakes
node.description: Friction 0..1 — all of the pedal when slow or battery full

node.label: Motor
node.description: 0..1, starter until engine RPS hits Start RPS

node.label: Motor Reverse
node.description: On in reverse

node.label: Gearbox 1
node.description: After motor, arrows toward motors, off 1:1, on 6:5, gears 2 4 6 8

node.label: Gearbox 2
node.description: 2nd, arrows toward motors, off 1:1, on 3:2, gears 3 4 7 8

node.label: Gearbox 3
node.description: Before wheels, arrows away from motors, off 2:1, on 1:1, gears 5-8

node.label: Instruments
node.description: Dials ch 1 engine RPS, ch 2 speed m/s, ch 3 battery, ch 4 gear

node.label: HUD
node.description: Debug overlay — wire to a video screen

object.script: gear = 1 drive_cl = 0 gen_cl = 0 scl_cl = 0 charging = false alive = false moving = false shift_t = 0 hud = { mode = '-', soc = 0, rps = 0, gear = 1, thr = 0, brk = 0, mot = 0, scl = 0, dcl = 0, gen = 0, eng = false, hold = false, ev = false, wheel = 0 } function towards(cur, target, step) local d = target - cur if d > step then d = step elseif d < -step then d = -step end cur = cur + d if cur < 0 then return 0 end if cur > 1 then return 1 end return cur end function onTick() local ign = input.getBool(1) local reverse = input.getBool(2) local ev = input.getBool(3) local hold = input.getBool(4) local rps = input.getNumber(1) local soc = input.getNumber(2) local wheel = input.getNumber(3) local vspd = input.getNumber(4) local ws = input.getNumber(5) local charge_thr = input.getNumber(6) local starter_thr = input.getNumber(7) local start_rps = input.getNumber(8) local idle_rps = input.getNumber(9) local step = input.getNumber(10) if step < 0.01 then step = 0.01 end local hyst = input.getNumber(11) local blend_rps = input.getNumber(12) if blend_rps < 0.01 then blend_rps = 0.01 end local soc_cut = input.getNumber(13) local soc_low = input.getNumber(14) local soc_gen = input.getNumber(15) local soc_full = input.getNumber(16) local fade = input.getNumber(17) if fade < 0.01 then fade = 0.05 end local throttle = math.max(ws, 0) local brake = math.max(-ws, 0) local braking = brake > 0.05 if throttle > 0.08 or reverse then moving = true elseif throttle < 0.02 and not reverse then moving = false end local driving = moving local batt_low = soc < soc_low local batt_need = soc <= soc_gen local batt_full = soc >= soc_full local batt_ok = soc > soc_cut if not ign then charging = false elseif batt_full then charging = false elseif batt_low or hold or ((not ev) and batt_need) then charging = true end if rps >= idle_rps then alive = true elseif rps < start_rps then alive = false end local engine_on = ign and (charging or hold or (driving and alive and not ev)) local cranking = engine_on and (not driving) and (not braking) and rps < start_rps -- Rest: lock clutch and motor-crank. Moving: HUD used to say HYBRID -- with clutch 0, so the diesel never got torque until you braked -- (rest crank). Slip the spinning motor onto the diesel, then open -- until idle, then fade to 1 for assist. local pull = 0 if engine_on and rps > idle_rps then pull = (rps - idle_rps) / 4 if pull > 1 then pull = 1 end end local scl_target = 0 if cranking then scl_target = 1 elseif engine_on and driving and rps < start_rps then scl_target = 0.25 elseif engine_on and driving then scl_target = pull end if not ign then scl_cl = 0 elseif cranking then scl_cl = 1 else scl_cl = towards(scl_cl, scl_target, fade) end local starter_clutch = scl_cl local drive_target = 0 if ign and driving then if hold then drive_target = scl_cl else drive_target = 1 end end if not ign then drive_cl = 0 else drive_cl = towards(drive_cl, drive_target, fade) end local gen_target = 0 local engine_thr = 0 if engine_on and alive then if driving then engine_thr = math.max(throttle, 0.55, charge_thr) if charging and not batt_full then if hold then gen_target = 0.2 else -- More gen as RPS rises. The old (1-pull) formula did the -- opposite and killed charge at speed. gen_target = 0.3 + 0.6 * pull end end else gen_target = 1 if charging and not batt_full then engine_thr = charge_thr end end end if not ign then gen_cl = 0 else gen_cl = towards(gen_cl, gen_target, fade) end local engine_gen = gen_cl local motor = 0 if cranking then motor = starter_thr elseif ign and batt_ok and not hold then if not braking then motor = throttle end end local reverse_out = reverse and ign and batt_ok if (not ign) or reverse then gear = 1 shift_t = 0 else shift_t = shift_t + 1 if shift_t >= 18 then shift_t = 0 if wheel > gear * step and gear < 8 then gear = gear + 1 elseif wheel < (gear - 1) * step - hyst and gear > 1 then gear = gear - 1 end end end local g = math.floor(gear - 1) local regen, brakes = 0, 0 if ign and braking then if batt_full then brakes = brake else local frac = wheel / blend_rps if frac < 0 then frac = 0 elseif frac > 1 then frac = 1 end regen = brake * frac brakes = brake * (1 - frac) end end output.setNumber(1, engine_thr) output.setNumber(2, starter_clutch) output.setNumber(3, drive_cl) output.setNumber(4, engine_gen) output.setNumber(5, regen) output.setNumber(6, brakes) output.setNumber(7, motor) output.setNumber(8, gear) output.setBool(1, engine_on) output.setBool(2, reverse_out) output.setBool(3, g % 2 ~= 0) output.setBool(4, math.floor(g / 2) % 2 ~= 0) output.setBool(5, math.floor(g / 4) % 2 ~= 0) local mode = 'OFF' if not ign then mode = 'OFF' elseif hold then mode = 'HOLD' elseif ev and not engine_on then mode = 'EV' elseif cranking or (engine_on and driving and rps < start_rps) then mode = 'START' elseif engine_on and driving then mode = 'HYBRID' elseif engine_on then mode = 'CHARGE' else mode = 'EV' end hud = { mode = mode, soc = soc, rps = rps, gear = gear, thr = throttle, brk = brake, mot = motor, scl = starter_clutch, dcl = drive_cl, gen = engine_gen, eng = engine_on, hold = hold, ev = ev, wheel = wheel, alive = alive, } end function onDraw() local w = screen.getWidth() local h = screen.getHeight() local d = hud screen.setColor(8, 12, 14) screen.drawClear() screen.setColor(40, 180, 90) screen.drawRectF(0, 0, math.floor(w * math.min(math.max(d.soc, 0), 1)), 4) screen.setColor(180, 50, 50) screen.drawRectF(0, 5, math.floor(w * math.min(d.rps / 20, 1)), 3) screen.setColor(220, 220, 210) screen.drawText(1, 10, d.mode) screen.drawText(1, 17, string.format('SOC %.2f', d.soc)) screen.drawText(1, 24, string.format('RPS %.1f', d.rps)) screen.drawText(1, 31, string.format('G%d W %.1f', d.gear, d.wheel)) screen.drawText(1, 38, string.format('M %.2f D %.2f', d.mot, d.dcl)) screen.drawText(1, 45, string.format('S %.0f GEN %.0f', d.scl, d.gen)) if d.eng then screen.setColor(80, 220, 90) screen.drawText(1, 52, 'ENG') else screen.setColor(120, 120, 120) screen.drawText(1, 52, 'eng') end if d.hold then screen.setColor(220, 180, 60) screen.drawText(20, 52, 'HOLD') end if d.ev then screen.setColor(80, 160, 220) screen.drawText(40, 52, 'EV') end screen.setColor(60, 70, 74) screen.drawRect(0, 0, w - 1, h - 1) end
